packages.vo: The Dangers in My Heart will end on the page before Season 3 even returns. Chapter 196 says it has three chapters left, while the anime's third season is coming in 2027. So Kyotaro and Anna's ending will not be a weekly anime surprise. Manga readers get there first, while the adaptation waits. That changes the finale conversation: there is no race to avoid spoilers when the page reaches the finish line first. The story ends in print before the next season begins. Do you read the last three chapters now, or wait for the anime to catch up? Leave your take.

packages.vo: Chained Soldier got a third season, but it did not get a date or a studio. The August second event gave fans an announcement video and a new visual, then stopped there. That restraint is the story: this is a green light, not a trailer cycle pretending the season is around the corner. Season two character designer Keiya Nakano also drew the celebratory illustration, giving the news a real handoff from the last season. But the next production team is still unknown. Is that enough to get excited, or do you wait for the first real details? Leave your take.
